delete_macs_rejected.description:
Reference Resource: [MAC](#/MAC)
List of MACs rejected and rejection reason for delete request in delete_macs_requested.

delete_macs_requested.description:
Reference Resource: [MAC](#/MAC)
Key is reference to Dynamic MACs rows requested to be deleted on this VLAN. Eventually these MACs will be cleared from the system and delete_macs_requested will revert to an empty list. If the value is true, the MAC will be force deleted if the MAC was not learnt through data plane

description.description: User provided description of this VLAN.

dhcpv4_snooping_enable.description: Enables DHCPv4 Snooping feature on the VLAN. DHCPv4 Snooping is active on the Ports of the VLAN only if the feature is enabled on the VLAN and globally.

dhcpv4_snooping_guard_policy.description:
Reference Resource: [DHCPv4_Snooping_Guard_Policy](#/DHCPv4_Snooping_Guard_Policy)
DHCPv4 Guard Policy for VLAN.

dhcpv4_snooping_ip_binding_disable.description: Disables learning of DHCPv4 Snooping binding entries. Only policy based packet inspection is performed.

dhcpv6_snooping_allow_bindings_on_truste.description: Allow binding entries to be learned on trusted port.

dhcpv6_snooping_enable.description: Enables DHCPv6 Snooping feature on the VLAN. DHCPv6 Snooping is active on the Ports of the VLAN only if the feature is enabled on the VLAN and globally.

dhcpv6_snooping_guard_policy.description:

dhcpv6_dropped_due_to_access_list_error.description: Number of DHCPv6 server packets dropped on the VLAN due to access list error.

dhcpv6_dropped_due_to_prefix_list_error.description: Number of DHCPv6 server packets dropped on the VLAN due to prefix list error.

dhcpv6_dropped_due_to_server_preference_.description: Number of DHCPv6 server packets dropped on the VLAN due to server preference error.

dhcpv6_forwarded.description: Number of DHCPv6 server packets forwarded on the VLAN where DHCPv6 Guard Policy is enabled.

dhcpv6_received.description: Number of DHCPv6 server packets received on the VLAN, where DHCPv6 Guard Policy is enabled.

dhcpv6_snooping_ip_binding_disable.description: Disables learning of DHCPv6 Snooping binding entries. Only policy based packet inspection is performed.

flood_enabled_subsystems.description:
Reference Resource: [Subsystem](#/Subsystem)
Reference to a list of [Subsystem](#/Subsystem) where VLAN flooding is programmed for this VLAN.

id.description:
Reference Resource: [VLAN](#/VLAN)
The ID of this VLAN. Non-internal VLANs must have an 'id' between 1 and 4094 to be effectively instantiated.

internal_usage.description: The key-value pairs that represent how this VLAN is used internally by the system.

l3port.description: VLAN is used internally by ASIC to configure L3 behavior of the port. The value is the port name that uses this VLAN.

ubt.description: VLAN is used internally by UBT to assign to the tunneled clients. The value is 'ubt'.

ipv4_source_lockdown_enable.description: Enables the IP Lockdown feature on the VLAN. When set, IPv4 traffic from clients on ports of this VLAN will be forwarded only when there is an associated IP binding entry.

ipv6_destination_guard_enable.description: Enables IPv6 destination guard feature on the VLAN. IPv6 destination guard is active on the Ports of the VLAN only if the both DHCPv6 snooping and ND snooping features are enabled on the VLAN and globally.

dropped_statistics.description: Number of unknown destination IPv6 packets dropped

ipv6_source_lockdown_enable.description: Enables the IP Lockdown feature on the VLAN. When set, IPv6 traffic from clients on ports of this VLAN will be forwarded only when there is an associated IP binding entry.

macs_invalid.description: If `true`, indicates that MACs on this VLAN are invalid. This might be set by any agent of the system that decides that MACs are indeed invalid. Eventually those MACs will be cleared from the system and macs_invalid will revert to `false`.

mgmd_counters.description: Statistics for the VLAN. This field value could either be empty or explicitly set to 0 to indicate that the counter is 0.

igmp_fast_leave_counter.description: Number of IGMP fast leaves happened on the VLAN.

igmp_forced_fast_leave_counter.description: Number of IGMP forced fast leaves happened on the VLAN.

igmp_membership_timeout_counter.description: Number of IGMP membership timeouts on the VLAN.

igmp_rx_malformed_pkt_counter.description: Number of malformed IGMP packets received on the VLAN.

igmp_rx_v3_group_specific_query_counter.description: Number of IGMPv3 group specific queries received on the VLAN.

igmp_rx_v3_gssq_counter.description: Number of IGMPv3 group and source specific queries received on the VLAN.

igmp_rx_v3_member_report_counter.description: Number of IGMPv3 membership reports received on the VLAN.

igmp_rx_wrong_version_query_counter.description: Number of IGMP query packets received on the VLAN with the version different from the configured version.

igmp_tx_forward_to_routers.description: Number of IGMP packets forwarded to the routers.

igmp_tx_v3_group_specific_query_counter.description: Number of IGMPv3 group specific query packets transmitted on the VLAN.

mld_tx_forward_to_routers.description: Number of MLD packets forwarded to the routers.

mld_tx_v1_group_specific_query_counter.description: Number of MLDv1 group specific query packets transmitted on the VLAN.

mld_tx_v2_group_specific_query_counter.description: Number of MLDv2 group specific query packets transmitted on the VLAN.

mgmd_drop_unknown_status.description: Indicates status of the drop unknown multicast traffic feature on the VLAN.`disabled` indicates that the feature is disabled. `exclusive_vlan_filter` indicates that an exclusive filter is used on the VLAN to forward unknown multicast traffic. `shared_vlan_filter` indicates that the common shared filter is used to forward unknown multicast traffic on the VLAN. `no_available_filter` indicates that multicast filter allocation failed and unknown multicast traffic will be flooded on all ports on the VLAN.

mgmd_dynamic_group_count.description: Count of dynamic groups in both the exclude and include mode on the VLAN.

igmp_exclude_mode.description: Count of dynamic IGMP groups in the exclude mode on the VLAN.

igmp_include_mode.description: Count of dynamic IGMP groups in the include mode on the VLAN.

mld_exclude_mode.description: Count of dynamic MLD groups in the exclude mode on the VLAN.

mld_include_mode.description: Count of dynamic MLD groups in the include mode on the VLAN.

mgmd_enable.description: Enable or disable IGMP/MLD on the VLAN. By default, IGMP/MLD is disabled on the VLAN.

mgmd_enable_status.description: Status field from the protocol to indicate if IGMP/MLD is enabled or not when `mgmd_enable` configuration is set to enable. By default it is false (disabled) for both IGMP and MLD.

mgmd_igmp_block_ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
List of [Port](#/Port) in block mode for IGMP. Instruct the device to drop incoming multicast packets received on the specified ports.

mgmd_igmp_fastleave_ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Enables or disables IGMP Fast Leaves. List of [Port](#/Port) with fastleave configured.

mgmd_igmp_forcedfastleave_ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
List of [Port](#/Port) with forced fastleave configured. When enabled, this feature forces IGMP Fast Leaves to occur even when the port is cascaded.

mgmd_igmp_forward_ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
List of [Port](#/Port) in forward mode for IGMP. Instruct the device to forward incoming multicast packets received on the specified ports.

mgmd_igmp_router_port_time_expiry.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The list of ports on which PIM routers are detected along with its expiry time in seconds. The expiry time is the time to expiry added with the system bootup time. The addition of system uptime ensures that the timer values don't need to be updated every clock tick.

mgmd_igmp_static_group_ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Specifies the list of ports for which Static join is configured for specific IPv4 multicast group and source address.

mgmd_igmp_static_groups.description: The list of IGMP static group IP addresses. The entries are stored in the Source_Group format.

mgmd_igmp_version.description: The IGMP protocol version to use. When IGMP snooping is disabled this field would be empty.

mgmd_mld_block_ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
List of [Port](#/Port) in block mode for MLD. Instruct the device to drop incoming multicast packets received on the specified ports.

mgmd_mld_fastleave_ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Enables or disables MLD fast leaves. The list of [Port](#/Port) with fastleave configured.

mgmd_mld_forcedfastleave_ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
List of the [Port](#/Port) with forced fastleave configured. When enabled, this feature forces MLD fast leaves to occur even when the port is cascaded.

mgmd_mld_forward_ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
List of the [Port](#/Port) in forward mode for MLD. Instruct the device to forward incoming multicast packets received on the specified ports.

mgmd_mld_router_port_time_expiry.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
List of the ports on which PIM routers are detected along with its expiry time in seconds. The expiry time is the time to expiry added with the system bootup time. The addition of system uptime ensures that the timer values don't need to be updated for every clock tick.

mgmd_mld_static_group_ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Specifies the list of ports for which Static join is configured for specific IPv6 multicast group and source address.

mgmd_mld_static_groups.description: List of MLD static group IP addresses. The entries are stored in the Source_Group format.

mgmd_mld_version.description: The MLD protocol version to use. When IGMP snooping is disabled, this field would be empty.

mgmd_oper_version.description: MGMD protocol could run in a version different from the configured version. This happens when there is both VLAN and interface VLAN entries with MGMD snooping and MGMD enabled respectively. The version would be negotiated to the lower of the configured versions in both of them. The operational version for both the IGMP snooping and MLD snooping on the VLAN.

mgmd_querier_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
[Port](#/Port) on which querier is detected.

mgmd_querier_timer_info.description: Timer parameters learned from the querier in seconds. The querier detected and querier expiry time values are added with the system bootup time. The addition of system uptime ensures that the timer values don't need to be updated every clock tick.

igmp_querier_detected_time.description: The time when the IGMP querier was first detected.

igmp_querier_expiry_time.description: The time when the IGMP querier would be considered unavailable.

igmp_querier_max_response_time.description: Maximum response time specified in the IGMP querier's query packet.

igmp_querier_query_interval.description: Query interval present in the IGMP querier's query packet.

igmp_querier_robustness_count.description: Querier robustness count present in the IGMP Querier's query packet.

mld_querier_detected_time.description: The time when the MLD querier was first detected.

mld_querier_expiry_time.description: The time when the MLD querier would be considered unavailable.

mld_querier_max_response_time.description: Maximum response time specified in the MLD querier's query packet.

mld_querier_query_interval.description: Query interval present in the MLD querier's query packet.

mld_querier_robustness_count.description: Querier robustness count present in the MLD querier's query packet.

mgmd_snooping_acl.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
Ingress ACL to filter processing of MGMD reports and leave messages received from hosts. When this is not configured, all MGMD reports and leave messages will be processed.

allow_bindings_on_trusted_ports.description: Allow binding entries to be learned on trusted port.

enable.description: Enables ND Snooping feature on the VLAN. ND Snooping is active on ports of the VLAN only if the feature is enabled at the system level and on the VLAN. This enables nd_guard and ra_guard by default.

nd_guard_enable.description: Enables ND-Guard feature on the VLAN. This takes effect only when Global and VLAN level ND Snooping is also enabled.

ra_drop_enable.description: Enables RA-drop feature on the VLAN. When enabled, RA packets received on the VLAN will be dropped regardless of whether they are received on ND Snooping 'trusted' or 'untrusted' ports. This takes effect only when ND Snooping is also enabled on the VLAN.

ra_guard_enable.description: Enables RA-guard feature on the VLAN. When enabled, RA(Router Advertisement) and RR(Router Redirect) packets received on the VLAN will be dropped on untrusted ports. This takes effect only when Global and VLAN level ND Snooping is also enabled.

ra_guard_log.description: Enables logging of RA(Router Advertisement)  and RR(Router Redirect) dropped packets. This takes effect only when ra_guard is enabled.

nd_snooping_prefix.description: List of network prefix ranges allowed on the VLAN. An ND packet with a source IP not matching any of the prefixes configured here will be dropped. If this is empty, source IP prefix validation is not performed.

oper_state_reason.description: Human readable reason for the operational state of this VLAN. error: Operational state is down due to an unknown reason. ok: Operational state is up for the VLAN. admin_down: VLAN is administratively down. no_member_port: No port is member of the VLAN. no_member_forwarding: No port is forwarding. private_vlan_violation: Private VLAN violation. pvlan_primary_down: Primary VLAN is operationally down.

policy_in_applied.description:
Reference Resource: [Policy](#/Policy)
Current, successfully applied ingress Policy to this VLAN, as identified in the [Policy](#/Policy)

policy_in_cfg.description:
Reference Resource: [Policy](#/Policy)
Ingress Classifier Policy, potentially in flight, desired to be applied to this VLAN, as identified in the [Policy](#/Policy). Ignored if configured on VLANs with type = 'internal'. An empty column value indicates that no list is applied for this type and direction.

policy_in_cfg_version.description: The version of the 'policy_in_cfg' column. This value is changed to a random value each time any management interface modifies the 'policy_in_cfg' value. Ignored if configured on VLANs with type = 'internal'. An empty column value will indicate that the user does not want the system to process this configuration yet.

policy_in_conform_rate.description: This is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. It is available at [Policy](#/Policy).

policy_in_data_plane_states.description:
Reference Resource: [Data_Plane](#/Data_Plane)
Application status for each data_plane (line card).

policy_in_statistics.description: This is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. It is available at [Policy](#/Policy).

policy_in_status.description: The status of the last version of the 'policy_in_cfg', that has been processed.

code.description: Numeric error code.  Expected to be 0 when state is 'applied'

message.description: Detailed reason for error state.  Expected empty when state is 'applied'

version.description: The version of policy_in_cfg that corresponds to this status.

pvlan_association.description:
Reference Resource: [VLAN](#/VLAN)
Specifies the Primary VLAN associated with this secondary VLAN This is applicable to Secondary VLANs only. When pvlan_association is not set and pvlan_type is set, then considered as misconfiguration and brought down the VLAN.

pvlan_type.description: Specifies the VLAN's type in the context of Private VLAN. When not set, it will work as regular VLAN.

pvlan_violation_reason.description: Human readable reason for why Private vlan violation occurred  on the VLAN. The value will be populated only when there is a PVLAN misconfiguration. pvlan_default_vlan_join: Default VLAN is not allowed to join Private-VLAN domain. pvlan_erps_inst_pvlans_mismatch: ERPS instances must match for all VLANs in a Private-VLAN domain. pvlan_invalid_primary_association: Secondary VLAN is associated with an invalid Primary VLAN. pvlan_mstp_inst_pvlans_mismatch: MSTP instances must match for all VLANs in a Private-VLAN domain. pvlan_mvrp_cfg_both_present: MVRP and Private-VLAN are mutually exclusive features. pvlan_no_primary_association: No Primary VLAN has been configured for Secondary VLAN. pvlan_primary_vlan_limit_exceeded: Maximum number of Primary VLANs reached. pvlan_rpvst_cfg_both_present: RPVST and Private-VLAN are mutually exclusive features. pvlan_secondary_vlan_limit_exceeded: Maximum number of secondary VLANs reached. pvlan_smartlink_group_pvlans_mismatch: Smartlink groups must match for all VLANs in a Private-VLAN domain. pvlan_vt_cfg_both_present: VLAN translation and PVLAN are mutually exclusive features. secondary_vlan_svi_present: VLAN is a secondary VLAN with SVI configured. pvlan_primary_has_association: VLAN is a primary VLAN but associated to another VLAN.

ra_guard_policy.description:
Reference Resource: [RA_Guard_Policy](#/RA_Guard_Policy)
RA Guard policy associated with this VLAN. RR/RA packets received on this VLAN will be inspected and permitted per the policy specification.

ra_dropped_due_to_access_list_error.description: Number of RA packets dropped on the VLAN due to access list error.

ra_dropped_due_to_hop_limit_error.description: Number of RA packets dropped on the VLAN due to hop limit error.

ra_dropped_due_to_manage_flag_error.description: Number of RA packets dropped on the VLAN due to manage flag error.

ra_dropped_due_to_other_flag_error.description: Number of RA packets dropped on the VLAN due to other flag error.

ra_dropped_due_to_prefix_list_error.description: Number of RA packets dropped on the VLAN due to prefix list error.

ra_dropped_due_to_router_preference_erro.description: Number of RA packets dropped on the VLAN due to router preference error.

ra_forwarded.description: Number of RA packets forwarded on the VLAN where RA Guard Policy enabled.

ra_received.description: Number of RA packets received on the VLAN, where  RA Guard Policy is enabled.

replication_group.description:
Reference Resource: [Replication_Group](#/Replication_Group)
The reference to the [Replication_Group](#/Replication_Group) contains a hardware multicast group which is used for VLAN flooding.

type.description: The value indicates whether the VLAN was statically configured, internal VLAN, default VLAN, was learned dynamically via a protocol like MVRP or learned via port-access authentication.

vsx_sync.description: Controls which attributes should be synchronized between VSX peers. 'all_attributes_and_dependents': the entire VLAN should be synchronized.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)

Ignored if configured on VLANs with type = 'internal'. An empty column value will indicate that the user does not want the system to process this configuration yet.

enable.description: Enables ND Snooping feature on the VLAN. ND Snooping is active on ports of the VLAN only if the feature is enabled at the system level and on the VLAN. This enables nd_guard and ra_guard by default.

nd_guard_enable.description: Enables ND-Guard feature on the VLAN. This takes effect only when Global and VLAN level ND Snooping is also enabled.

ra_drop_enable.description: Enables RA-drop feature on the VLAN. When enabled, RA packets received on the VLAN will be dropped regardless of whether they are received on ND Snooping 'trusted' or 'untrusted' ports. This takes effect only when ND Snooping is also enabled on the VLAN.

ra_guard_enable.description: Enables RA-guard feature on the VLAN. When enabled, RA(Router Advertisement) and RR(Router Redirect) packets received on the VLAN will be dropped on untrusted ports. This takes effect only when Global and VLAN level ND Snooping is also enabled.

ra_guard_log.description: Enables logging of RA(Router Advertisement)  and RR(Router Redirect) dropped packets. This takes effect only when ra_guard is enabled.

nd_snooping_prefix.description: List of network prefix ranges allowed on the VLAN. An ND packet with a source IP not matching any of the prefixes configured here will be dropped. If this is empty, source IP prefix validation is not performed.

parameters.name: VLAN.id
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VLAN](#/VLAN)
The ID of this VLAN. Non-internal VLANs must have an 'id' between 1 and 4094 to be effectively instantiated.
